title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

 

We’re building the Production ready system from the PoC and looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who enjoys creating scalable products and taking ownership of real technical decisions. You’ll work closely with product and design teams, shape parts of the architecture, and help turn ideas into a production-ready platform.

 

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of software development experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern ES6+
  • Strong experience with React and Next.js
  • Strong experience with backend development using Node.js / NestJS
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL
  • Hands-on experience with MQTT
  • Experience building applications that can be deployed on both OnPrem and Cloud platforms
  • Experience building scalable applications and contributing to system architecture
  • Ability to take ownership of features and technical solutions
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, product-driven environments
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Upper-Intermediate English (B2+)

 

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with React Native or WebSockets
  • Experience working in startup or early-stage environments
  • Experience with Azure, IoT Hub, Microsoft Entra ID
  • Previous experience mentoring engineers or contributing to technical leadership

 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver key features of a new product from concept to launch
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable frontend and backend architecture
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams
  • Take ownership of technical solutions and help drive implementation
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high engineering standards
  • Contribute to development best practices and team workflows
  • Support and mentor less experienced engineers when needed
  • Continuously improve performance, reliability, and scalability of the platform.
